12.0.en: A hard week [[loom:looms]] ahead, but Leo stays calm and begins to [[sort:sort]] his cards by topic.
12.0.zh: 艰难的一周已迫在眉睫，但利奥沉着应对，开始按主题整理他的卡片。

12.1.en: To [[commence:commence]] well is to [[launch:launch]] the day with a clear [[purpose:purpose]].
12.1.zh: 好的开端，就是带着清晰的目标启动新的一天。

12.2.en: He would not [[exploit:exploit]] others, but [[explore:explore]] new paths of his own.
12.2.zh: 他从不利用别人，而是自己探索新的道路。

12.3.en: If you [[exert:exert]] real effort, you [[tackle:tackle]] each [[challenge:challenge]] head-on.
12.3.zh: 只要肯下真功夫，你就能正面迎上每一个挑战。

12.4.en: He learned to [[cope:cope]] with stress and to [[dispose:dispose]] of useless worry.
12.4.zh: 他学会了应对压力，也学会了放下无用的担忧。

12.5.en: His [[conduct:conduct]] stayed honest, with nothing important left to [[omit:omit]].
12.5.zh: 他的行为始终诚实，没有任何要紧的东西被漏掉。

13.0.en: He [[erase:erases]] wrong answers quickly and [[rescue:rescues]] useful ideas from past mistakes.
13.0.zh: 他会迅速擦掉错误的答案，再从过去的错误里拾回有用的想法。

13.1.en: Leo will [[recover:recover]] his strength with short walks, rather than [[resort:resorting]] to long naps.
13.1.zh: 利奥靠短途散步恢复体力，而不是靠长时间的午睡。

13.2.en: Warm tea [[can:can]] [[restore:restore]] calm focus and help [[rectify:rectify]] small grammar slips.
13.2.zh: 热茶能找回平静的专注，还能帮忙纠正小小的语法疏漏。

13.3.en: Extra practice [[can:can]] [[redeem:redeem]] past lazy days and [[offset:offset]] weak spelling skills.
13.3.zh: 额外的练习能弥补过去偷懒的日子，也能抵掉拼写上的短板。

13.4.en: Fresh [[fruit:fruit]] [[can:can]] [[replenish:replenish]] his energy and help him [[obtain:obtain]] [[steady:steady]] evening focus.
13.4.zh: 新鲜水果能补足他的能量，帮他获得夜晚稳定的专注力。

13.5.en: The [[library:library]] [[can:can]] [[supply:supply]] [[quiet:quiet]] desks that [[offer:offer]] warm light for long reading.
13.5.zh: 图书馆能提供安静的书桌，暖暖的灯光正好适合长时间阅读。

14.0.en: Tutors [[can:can]] [[render:render]] hard lessons simple and [[enlarge:enlarge]] small steps into big gains.
14.0.zh: 家教能把难课讲得简单，把小步的进步放大成大收获。

14.1.en: Pictures [[can:can]] [[augment:augment]] dull texts and [[magnify:magnify]] tiny details for tired eyes.
14.1.zh: 图片能为枯燥的课文增色，把微小的细节放大给疲惫的眼睛看。

14.2.en: Microphones [[can:can]] [[amplify:amplify]] soft voices, but teachers never [[exaggerate:exaggerate]] a student's small errors.
14.2.zh: 话筒能放大轻柔的声音，老师却从不夸大学生的小错误。

14.3.en: Short breaks never [[prolong:prolong]] too long, and Leo [[uphold:upholds]] firm sleeping hours.
14.3.zh: 课间休息从不拖得太长，利奥也坚持严格的作息。

14.4.en: Saved notes act as a strong [[backup:backup]] and [[can:can]] [[propel:propel]] Leo toward higher bands.
14.4.zh: 存好的笔记是坚实的后盾，能推动利奥冲向更高的分数。

14.5.en: Leo will [[update:update]] his word lists nightly and slowly [[raise:raise]] his practice [[test:test]] scores.
14.5.zh: 利奥每晚更新单词表，模考成绩也在慢慢提高。

15.0.en: Rain may [[leak:leak]] through the old windows and [[spill:spill]] cold water onto the [[wooden:wooden]] desks.
15.0.zh: 雨水可能从旧窗缝漏进来，把冷水洒在木桌上。

15.1.en: [[damp:Damp]] air can [[seep:seep]] through the cracks and make the old paint [[ooze:ooze]] with moisture.
15.1.zh: 潮气会从裂缝渗进来，让旧漆也洇出湿痕。

15.2.en: Students need not [[evacuate:evacuate]] the hall, but they must avoid the [[muddy:muddy]] [[trench:trench]] near the gates.
15.2.zh: 学生们不必撤离大厅，但要避开大门附近那条泥泞的水沟。

15.3.en: Heavy rain [[can:can]] [[saturate:saturate]] shoes quickly — a fair [[excuse:excuse]] for arriving a little late.
15.3.zh: 大雨能很快浸透鞋子——这也是稍微迟到的一个正当借口。

15.4.en: Teachers will [[forgive:forgive]] the late arrivals and help young minds [[contain:contain]] worry and fright.
15.4.zh: 老师会原谅迟到的脚步，也帮年轻的心收住担忧与惊慌。

15.5.en: Leo shows deep [[regard:regard]] for the cleaners, and never uses lies to [[flatter:flatter]] his teachers.
15.5.zh: 利奥对保洁员深怀敬意，也从不用谎话奉承老师。

16.0.en: He does not blindly [[worship:worship]] high scores, nor fight for a [[narrow:narrow]] [[cause:cause]].
16.0.zh: 他不盲目崇拜高分，也不为狭隘的目标而战。

16.1.en: For the [[sake:sake]] of his family's love, Leo keeps a clear study [[purpose:purpose]].
16.1.zh: 为了家人的爱，利奥始终保有清晰的学习目标。

16.2.en: Each small [[objective:objective]] [[can:can]] slowly [[arouse:arouse]] fresh hope in his tired heart.
16.2.zh: 每一个小目标都能慢慢唤起他疲惫心里的新希望。

16.3.en: A low score may [[trigger:trigger]] worry, but Leo will still [[seek:seek]] wise help.
16.3.zh: 低分也许会触发担忧，但利奥仍会去寻求明智的帮助。

16.4.en: He [[can:can]] [[retrieve:retrieve]] old notes fast, and let the results [[testify:testify]] to his hard work.
16.4.zh: 他能迅速找回旧笔记，让成绩自己证明他下的苦功。

16.5.en: Leo will [[verify:verify]] his answers twice and [[specify:specify]] a clear time for each task.
16.5.zh: 利奥会把答案核对两遍，并为每项任务清楚定好时间。

17.0.en: Good books [[can:can]] [[enlighten:enlighten]] young minds and warmly [[impart:impart]] timeless study skills.
17.0.zh: 好书能启发年轻的心，也温暖地传授经得起时间考验的学习方法。

17.1.en: Hard workers truly [[deserve:deserve]] good bands, and never let their focus [[drop:drop]] at [[night:night]].
17.1.zh: 下苦功的人真正配得上好分数，夜里也从不让专注松懈下来。

17.2.en: Leo will not let hope [[sink:sink]] low, nor let scores [[plummet:plummet]] after lazy nights.
17.2.zh: 利奥不会让希望沉下去，也不会让成绩因偷懒的夜晚而暴跌。

17.3.en: He learns to [[muffle:muffle]] the [[phone:phone]] noise, so stress cannot [[overshadow:overshadow]] his calm thinking.
17.3.zh: 他学着压低手机的声响，不让烦恼盖过平静的思考。

17.4.en: At [[dawn:dawn]] he will [[greet:greet]] his mother and proudly [[salute:salute]] the morning flag.
17.4.zh: 黎明时分，他会向妈妈道早安，并自豪地向晨旗敬礼。

17.5.en: Teachers will [[congratulate:congratulate]] his [[progress:progress]], and kind elders will [[bless:bless]] his brave path.
17.5.zh: 老师会祝贺他的进步，慈爱的长辈也会祝福他勇敢前行的路。

18.0.en: Leo wants to [[participate:participate]] in contests before waving a last [[farewell:farewell]] to his fears.
18.0.zh: 利奥想先参加几场比赛，再向心里的恐惧挥手作最后的告别。

18.1.en: He will [[assort:assort]] his notes by color, so that each answer still [[correspond:corresponds]] to its question.
18.1.zh: 他会按颜色把笔记分类，好让每个答案都还与问题一一对应。

18.2.en: The teachers act in kind [[accord:accord]] with the rules, and [[attribute:attribute]] his gains to [[steady:steady]] effort.
18.2.zh: 老师们做事与规则十分一致，并把他的进步归功于持续的努力。

18.3.en: Leo [[can:can]] [[recall:recall]] the morning words well, and quietly [[recollect:recollect]] the evening grammar rules.
18.3.zh: 利奥能清楚记起早晨的单词，也能安静回想晚间的语法规则。

18.4.en: Short cards [[can:can]] [[remind:remind]] him of phrases, so he [[can:can]] [[retell:retell]] stories simply.
18.4.zh: 小小的卡片能提醒他短语，他就能用简单的话复述故事。

18.5.en: Leo will [[repeat:repeat]] key sentences aloud and write a calm [[retrospect:retrospect]] of the day each night.
18.5.zh: 利奥会大声重复重点句，每晚还写下一段对当天的平静回顾。

19.0.en: [[steady:Steady]] habits [[can:can]] [[impress:impress]] the sternest judges and help Leo [[surmount:surmount]] his final [[test:test]] fears.
19.0.zh: 稳定的习惯能给最严格的评委留下印象，帮利奥克服期末考试的恐惧。

19.1.en: Small failures need not [[mortify:mortify]] young hearts, while calm hope [[can:can]] [[pervade:pervade]] the room.
19.1.zh: 小小的失败不必让年轻的心蒙羞，平静的希望却会弥漫整个房间。

19.2.en: To [[replace:replace]] the old part is to [[substitute:substitute]] it entirely.
19.2.zh: 把旧零件换下来，就是将它彻底替代掉。

19.3.en: He learned to [[differentiate:differentiate]] truth from lies, and to [[distinguish:distinguish]] friends from [[foe:foes]].
19.3.zh: 他学会了分辨真话与谎言，也学会了分清朋友与对手。

19.4.en: He would not [[incline:incline]] toward [[anger:anger]], nor [[lean:lean]] on excuses.
19.4.zh: 他不会动不动就发怒，也不会拿借口当依靠。

19.5.en: At last Leo turns [[sideways:sideways]] to smile at the moon, and then falls asleep with hope.
19.5.zh: 最后，利奥侧过身对着月亮微笑，然后满怀希望地睡去。

20.0.en: Grandma used to lose her [[temper:temper]] quickly, yet she always spoke in a soft [[manner:manner]] at home.
20.0.zh: 奶奶以前容易发脾气，可在家里说话的样子总是柔声细语。

20.1.en: Her calm [[attitude:attitude]] shows her warm and kind [[personality:personality]] to us all.
20.1.zh: 她平和的态度，向我们大家展现出她温暖善良的个性。

20.2.en: Patience is her best [[trait:trait]], and kindness is her greatest [[virtue:virtue]] in life.
20.2.zh: 耐心是她最好的特质，善良则是她一生最大的美德。

20.3.en: Her smile is her special [[feature:feature]], though age has bent her back and left her [[stature:stature]] smaller than before.
20.3.zh: 她的微笑是她最特别的地方，只是岁月压弯了她的背，个子也比从前矮了。

20.4.en: She likes to say that the [[flesh:flesh]] is weak — and that is true for all [[mankind:mankind]].
20.4.zh: 她总爱说，血肉之躯都是软弱的——全人类都是如此。

20.5.en: The doctor said the [[bone:bone]] in her leg has grown soft, and Grandpa jokes that he is still the [[backbone:backbone]] of our house.
20.5.zh: 医生说她腿上的骨头变软了，爷爷却打趣说，他还是这个家的顶梁柱呢。

21.0.en: On the wall chart the full [[skeleton:skeleton]] and the [[round:round]] [[skull:skull]] show up very clearly.
21.0.zh: 墙上的挂图把完整的骨架和圆圆的头骨展示得清清楚楚。

21.1.en: A strong [[brain:brain]] needs good sleep, and a calm [[mind:mind]] needs love every day.
21.1.zh: 强健的大脑需要好的睡眠，平静的心每天都需要爱。

21.2.en: Grandma needs both [[physical:physical]] care and warm [[mental:mental]] support from the family.
21.2.zh: 奶奶既需要身体上的照顾，也需要家人温暖的心理支持。

21.3.en: The [[nurse:nurse]] touches her red [[cheek:cheek]] and warm [[forehead:forehead]] with [[gentle:gentle]] hands.
21.3.zh: 护士用轻柔的手，摸了摸她发红的脸颊和发热的前额。

21.4.en: Sweat stands on her [[brow:brow]], and tears hang on her long [[eyelash:eyelashes]] that morning.
21.4.zh: 那天早晨，汗珠挂在她的额头上，泪水挂在长长的睫毛上。

21.5.en: Her dry [[lip:lips]] are bitten, and she asks for more [[space:space]] to breathe in the room.
21.5.zh: 她干干的嘴唇都咬破了，还请求屋里多留些能喘气的空间。

22.0.en: She puts out her [[tongue:tongue]], and the doctor looks deep into her red [[throat:throat]] quickly.
22.0.zh: 她伸出舌头，医生很快朝她红红的喉咙深处看了看。

22.1.en: She lifts her small [[chin:chin]] to answer loudly, remembering the green [[gorge:gorge]] where she lived as a girl.
22.1.zh: 她抬起小小的下巴大声回答，想起小时候住过的那道绿色峡谷。

22.2.en: Her stiff [[jaw:jaw]] aches a little, so she slowly moves her long [[neck:neck]] left and right.
22.2.zh: 她僵硬的下巴有点疼，便慢慢把长长的脖子左右转了转。

22.3.en: Grandpa strokes his grey [[beard:beard]] and lays his hand softly on her shaking [[shoulder:shoulder]].
22.3.zh: 爷爷捋着花白的胡须，把手轻轻搭在她颤抖的肩膀上。

22.4.en: Her tired [[limb:limb]] feels heavy, and she rests her aching [[elbow:elbow]] on the edge of the table.
22.4.zh: 她疲惫的肢体沉甸甸的，只好把酸痛的肘部靠在桌沿上。

22.5.en: The [[nurse:nurse]] holds her thin [[wrist:wrist]] and asks her to press down hard with her [[thumb:thumb]] for a strength [[test:test]].
22.5.zh: 护士握住她细细的手腕，让她用大拇指使劲下按，做一个小小的力气测试。

23.0.en: Grandma opens her warm [[palm:palm]] and points with one shaking [[finger:finger]] at the chart.
23.0.zh: 奶奶张开温暖的手掌，用一根颤抖的手指指着挂图。

23.1.en: The [[first:first]] check is to listen to her broad [[chest:chest]] with a black [[tube:tube]].
23.1.zh: 第一项检查是用一根黑色的管子听她宽阔的胸腔。

23.2.en: Then the doctor presses her soft [[abdomen:abdomen]] and counts each lower [[rib:rib]] one by one.
23.2.zh: 接着医生按了按她柔软的腹部，把下面一根根肋骨数了过去。

23.3.zh: 他在她细细的腰上系好一根带子。

23.4.zh: 然后，回声波照出了每一个内部器官。

23.5.en: He says her [[liver:liver]] looks [[fine:fine]], but her empty [[stomach:stomach]] needs warm food every day.
23.5.zh: 他说她的肝脏看着挺好，只是空空的胃每天都需要热乎的饭食。

23.6.en: Years ago her [[womb:womb]] carried my mother, and now one [[kidney:kidney]] no longer works as well as before.
23.6.zh: 多年前，她的子宫里孕育了我的妈妈；如今她有一个肾也不如从前好用了。

paraZh.12: 艰难一周临近，利奥定目标迎挑战抛杂念。
paraZh.13: 擦错拾新散步提神，图书馆暖光伴夜读。
paraZh.14: 善用工具放大进步，守好作息稳步提分。
paraZh.15: 雨天教室漏雨路滑，师生互谅互敬。
paraZh.16: 不为虚荣只为家人，目标明确踏实求进。
paraZh.17: 好书授法晨起敬礼，利奥在祝福中前行。
paraZh.18: 分类笔记迎战比赛，晨词晚法记得牢。
paraZh.19: 辨真伪远怒气，利奥含笑入梦。
paraZh.20: 奶奶温和慈祥却日渐佝偻，全家陪她看病。
paraZh.21: 诊室挂图前问诊，护士轻抚奶奶心头暖。
paraZh.22: 查喉抬颚转颈肩，家人细心陪伴检查。
paraZh.23: 听胸按腹量腰围，声波照出内脏旧疾。
